title: UNVEILING THE SAFETY OF GPT-4O: AN EMPIRICAL STUDY USING JAILBREAK ATTACKS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of models when presented with textual queries categorized under 'Bias' from the RedTeam-2K dataset, evaluated using string matching and LLM-as-a-judge classifiers (Llama Guard, ChatGPT, and GPT-4o).
Evaluating the model's vulnerability to jailbreak attacks designed to elicit hate speech across multiple modalities (text and image) using benchmarks like RedTeam-2K, SafeBench, and MM-SafetyBench.
